changelog:
- Initial release: Adds auto-start patch and UI toggle for FnOS OpenClaw.
- Automatically starts openclaw-gateway on boot via injected logic in server/index.js.
- Provides a persistent toggle switch in the management page UI to enable or disable auto-start.
- Includes new API endpoints (GET/POST) for querying and setting auto-start status.
- Does not hardcode line numbers for compatibility with different bundle versions; patch logic is carefully injected based on code patterns.
summary: FnOS OpenClaw 开机自启补丁 + 管理页面开关。修改监控端 server/index.js 和 ui/index.html，实现可开关的开机启动。
